rule.dwarf-card.class.5:
Warrior: Their Bravery Value is equal to the sum of their Bravery Points, to which the Elvaland who gets the majority in ranks in the Warrior column adds their coin of highest value.

In case of a tie, all tied Elvalands add their highest value coin to their Warrior Bravery Value.
rule.dwarf-card.class.2:
Hunter: Their Bravery Value is equal to the number of Hunters squared.

To make counting easier, refer to the box on your individual board in front of the last rank of this column.
rule.dwarf-card.class.3: Miner: Their Bravery Value is equal to the sum of their Bravery Points multiplied by the number of ranks in their column.
rule.dwarf-card.class.1:
Blacksmith: Their Bravery Value is a mathematical sequence (+3, +4, +5, +6...).

To make counting easier, refer to the box on your individual board in front of the last rank of this column.
rule.dwarf-card.class.4: Explorer: Their Bravery Value is equal to the sum of their Bravery Points.
royal-offering.name: Royal Offering
rule.royal-offering:
When choosing the Royal Offering card, you gain a Transform a Coin effect.

Transform a Coin: Select a coin on your board to discard, then take a new coin from the Royal Treasure with a value equal to the discarded coin value +{additionalValue} (obtained by this card).

This card is placed in the discard once chosen.
rule.hero.500:
Has 3 ranks.

Immediately after placing Bonfur in the Blacksmith column, discard the last Dwarf card from another column of your choice.
rule.hero.502:
Has 3 ranks.

Immediately after placing Dagda in the Hunter column, discard the last Dwarf card from two other columns of your choice. The two columns must be different.
rule.hero.504:
Has 2 ranks.

Add 7 and 0 points to your Warrior Bravery Value.
rule.hero.505:
Has 1 rank.

Add 14 points to your Warrior Bravery Value.
rule.hero.506:
Has 1 rank.

Increases by 3 the sum of the Bravery Points of the Miners and by 1 the multiplicator factor (1 rank) for the calculation of the Miner Bravery Value.
rule.hero.507:
Has 1 rank.

Add 1, 0 and 0 points to the Bravery Points of the Miners.

Increases by 1 the sum of the Bravery Points of the Miners and by 3 the multiplicator factor (3 ranks) for the calculation of the Miner Bravery Value.
rule.hero.508:
Has 1 rank.

Add 7 points to the Bravery Points of the Explorers plus 2 points per rank present in her column, including her own.
rule.hero.509:
Has 1 rank.

Add 20 points to the Bravery Points of the Explorers.

Condition: You need to have 5 ranks in the Explorer column in your army in order to recruit her.

Note: the rank of Thrud and Ylud counts for Hourya's recruitment if they are placed in the Explorer column.
rule.hero.510:

X is the value of the largest coin you own.
rule.hero.511:
Add X points to your Final Bravery Value.

X depends on the number of recruited brothers.

Add X points to your Final Bravery Value.

X depends on the number of recruited brothers.
rule.hero.515:
Add X points to your Final Bravery Value.

rule.hero.516:
Place her in the column of your choice in your army.
Thrud should never be covered. If a Dwarf or Hero card should be placed on Thrud, take her in hand, place the Dwarf or Hero card in the column and replace Thrud in the column of your choice (its original column or another).
Placing her may trigger the recruitment of a new Hero card.

The rank of Thrud counts in the attribution of Distinctions of Age 1 in the column where she is. After the resolution of the last tavern of Age 2 and before the countdown of your Final Bravery Value, she is placed in your Command Zone.

She adds 13 points to your Final Bravery Value.
rule.hero.517:
After the resolution of the last tavern of Age 1 but before the Troop Evaluation, place Ylud in the column of your choice in your army. Ylud's rank counts as a card of this class for the attribution of Distinctions.

After the resolution of the last tavern of Age 2 but before the countdown of Bravery Values:

If she is in your Command Zone, place her in the column of your choice within your army,
If she is in your army, you can move her into another column of your choice.

Consider Ylud as a Dwarf of this class. She takes the value corresponding to the column where she is at the end of Age 2 (<1>Blacksmith</1> and <2>Hunter</2>: depending on the placement level, <3>Explorer: 11</3>, <4>Warrior: 7</4>, <5>Miner: 1</5>).

Placing Ylud in your army may trigger the recruitment of a Hero card.
rule.hero.518: Add 17 points to your Final Bravery Value.
rule.hero.519:
Add 9 points to your Final Bravery Value.
Each turn, during the bid phase, you do not place your coins on your individual board and keep them in your hand.
At the Resolution of the taverns, you wait for the other Elvalands to reveal their coins to pick yours and place them on the corresponding Tavern spot, face up.
During a coin trade, you must choose, at the end of your turn, which coins from your hand you add up to make the trade.

When you recruit Uline, you immediately take control of your coins on the Tavern spots that are not resolved this turn, as well as those in your pouch.
rule.hero.520:
Add 7 points to your Final Bravery Value.
When you recruit her, immediately add +7 to one of your coins (Transform a coin).

Transform a coin: Select a coin on your board to discard, then take a new coin from the Royal Treasure with a value equal to the discarded coin value +{additionalValue} (obtained by this card).

rule.coin.board.mine:

Until the revelation phase, this coin's value is only visible to you.
In the revelation phase, every coin on the current tavern is revealed, then the turn order depends on the players' coin values (from the highest to the lowest coin value).

Until the revelation phase, this coin's value is only visible to {player}.
In the revelation phase, every coin on the current tavern is revealed, then the turn order depends on the players' coin values (from the highest to the lowest coin value).
rule.coin.treasure:
This coin is in the Royal Treasure.

You can exchange your coins for these tokens via a coin trade or transformation.
When a gold coin is traded or transformed, it goes back to the Royal Treasure.

rule.coin.discard:
This coin is in discard.
When a bronze coin is traded or transformed, it goes to the discard.
rule.coin.exchange-coin:
This coin is a special coin. It is used to trigger a coin trade.
It cannot be traded or transformed.
rule.coin.hunting-master: This coin replaces the original exchange coin (bronze coin with value 0) if you win the Hunting Master Distinction during the Troop Evaluation.
rule.gem.description:
In the event of a tie in the value of the coins played for a tavern, the turn order is defined by the value of the gem possessed by the tied Elvalands.
You become the active Elvaland if you have the highest value gem.

The resolution continues in descending order of gem value until each tied Elvaland has played.

At the end of a tavern resolution, a trade of gems is made between the Elvalands tied for a given coin value. Once the trades are made, gems are placed back into their respective cavities.

<0>Tie between 2 Elvalands</0>: The gems are traded between them.
<0>Tie between 3 Elvalands</0>: Only the lowest value gem and the highest value gem are traded. The medium value gem is not traded.
<0>Tie between 4 Elvalands</0>: The lowest value gem and the highest value gem are traded. The other two gems are traded between them.
<0>Tie between 5 Elvalands</0>: The trade happens as for 4 Elvalands. The medium value gem is not traded.
rule.gem.crown-jeweler:
Special value 6 gem obtained via the Crown Jeweler Distinction. This gem cannot be traded.

This means that during a gem trade, this gem is ignored to make the exchange.
rule.distinction.1: Add +5 immediately to one of your coins (Coin Transformation).
rule.distinction.2:
Trade your coin of value 0 immediately with the special coin of value 3.
This special coin keeps its trading properties and cannot be transformed.
rule.distinction.3:
Place the special value 6 gem on your current gem.
You will add 3 points to your Final Bravery Value.

This gem will never be traded, even in the event of a tie with another Elvaland, and will allow you to win all ties at tavern resolutions.
rule.distinction.4:
Immediately add the special Blacksmith card with 2 ranks to your army.
Placing this card may trigger a recruitment of Hero cards.
rule.distinction.5:
Draw 3 cards from the Age 2 deck, keep 1:

If it is a Dwarf card, place it immediately in your army.
Placing this card may trigger the recruitment of a Hero card.

If it is a Royal Offering card, transform one of your coins.

The two unassigned cards are shuffled back into the Age 2 deck.

If this Distinction is not won, discard the first card of the Age 2 deck, without effect.
pouch.name: Pouch
rule.tavern:
A game turn consists of 3 taverns. They are resolved one after the other.

Before each tavern is resolved, all the coins on the Tavern spot of the individual boards are revealed.
Then, each Elvaland, starting with the one with the highest value coin (in the event of a tie, the one with the highest value gem), chooses a card and places it in their army.

At the end of each tavern, a gem exchange is performed between Elvalands with equal coin values.
rule.pouch:
This is one of your 2 spots in the pouch.
Coins placed here are revealed only if you reveal an exchange coin in a tavern.

When you reveal this coin, you exchange the two coins in the pouch with a new coin equal to their sum.
If there is no coin in the Royal Treasure equal to the sum, you will get the next available higher value coin in the Royal Treasure, otherwise the next available lower value coin in the Royal Treasure.
rule.playerboard.name: {player}'s player board
rule.playerboard.text:
During the bid phase, you place your coins on this board.
There is one slot per tavern and two slots for the pouch.

Hunter: To determine your Bravery Value, refer to the green boxes (column with icon <0/>).

Blacksmith: To determine your Bravery Value, refer to the purple boxes (column with icon <1/>).

tuto.intro: In this game, you play an <0>Elvaland</0> commissioned by the <0>King of the Dwarves</0> to form an army capable of defeating the infamous <0>Fafnir</0>!
tuto.tavern: Here are some Dwarves to recruit! They can be found in the <0>3 taverns</0> of the kingdom.
tuto.tresor: And there's your treasure. Thanks to these coins, you'll be able to convince the best Dwarves to join you!
tuto.bid: Each round begins with the <0>Bids</0>: you must place 3 coins on the 3 taverns.
tuto.coin: Place your coin of value {coin} here.
tuto.coin.other: Your opponent places his pieces at the same time as you.
tuto.pouch: Place the last two coins in your pouch.
tuto.resolution.1: Once all players have placed their bets, the taverns are resolved, starting with the <0>Laughing Goblin</0> tavern.
tuto.revealed: The coins bet on this tavern are revealed, and the player who bet the highest-value coin recruits first!
tuto.warrior: Your opponent has recruited this Warrior.
tuto.resolution.2: After each player has recruited a Dwarf, the next tavern is resolved.
tuto.exchange-coin: You've played your value-0 coin: in addition to recruiting a Dwarf, this coin allows you to exchange a coin from your pouch for a higher-value coin!
tuto.exchange: In your pouch, face down, are coins worth 5 and 3. You must exchange <0>the highest of the 2</0> for a coin worth <0>the sum of the 2</0>. So you're going to exchange the value-5 coin for a value-8 coin from the Royal Treasure.
tuto.resolution.3: Now it's time to resolve the last tavern. This time, you have the highest coin.
tuto.royal-offering.me:
This card is a <0>Royal Offering</0>. It allows you to immediately exchange a coin for a coin of value +3.
Choose this card by clicking on it for 1 second.
tuto.transform: Now click on your coin of value 2 to trade it for a coin of value 5.
tuto.endturn.1:
The first round is over!
At the start of each round, the taverns fill up, and it's a new betting phase.
tuto.tie: You played a coin of the same value as your opponent in the Dancing Dragon Tavern!
tuto.gem:
In the event of a tie, these <0>gems</0> determine who wins. You have the most valuable gem, so you can recruit first!
But beware: <0>after recruiting, you'll exchange your gems</0>.
tuto.rank: Each dwarf has a rank here.
tuto.recruitment: You have the right to <0>recruit a Hero</0> as soon as you complete a line with <0>one rank of each Dwarf class</0>.
tuto.heroes: Meet the Heroes. Every Hero is unique.
tuto.aral: Recruit <0>Aral Eagle Claws</0>. This Hunter-class Hero has <0>2 ranks</0>.
tuto.endturn.2:
The second round is over!
This is the <0>Age I</0> deck, which is used to fill the taverns. At the end of the turn when it's empty, <0>the King evaluates the troops and awards the Distinctions.</0>
tuto.distinctions: Here are the Distinctions. For each class, the player with the most ranks wins the corresponding Distinction.
tuto.endage.1: Once Age I has been completed, the taverns are filled with <0>the Age II deck</0>.
tuto.endgame: The game ends at the end of Age II.
tuto.score:
The player with the most Bravery Points wins.
Every Dwarf brings you Bravery Points, and your coins count too.
tuto.go:
Now it's your turn to play!
To find out what the Dwarves, Heroes and Distinctions do, <0>just click on them</0>.
Good luck, and be brave!
rule.end-age-1:
At the end of the turn when the Age 1 deck has been exhausted, a Troop Evaluation is performed by the King.
The Elvaland with the strict majority of ranks in each class wins the corresponding Distinction.
In the event of a tie, no one takes the corresponding Distinction card.
The gems do not settle ties during the Troop Evaluation.
rule.recruitment:
When placing a Dwarf card in your army, creating a line consisting of one rank of each class requires you to immediately choose an available Hero card.

To recruit a Hero, the number of complete rank lines in your army must always be equal to your number of recruited Hero cards + 1.
